posts.zh:
dsh-hot-reload 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。插件升级后在运行中的 dsh 内直接重载，无需重启；重载失败时回滚到旧版本并提示手动重启。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fff416d66b76a8e884f0.html
posts.en:
dsh-hot-reload is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Reloads an upgraded plugin inside the running dsh process instead of restarting it, and rolls back to the old version when a reload fails.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fff416d66b76a8e884f0.html
